lines.zh: 我拍着尾巴，在浪里往前冲。
lines.en: I beat my tail and drive forward through the waves.

lines.zh: 海浪推我，我偏要顶上去。
lines.en: The sea pushes me, and I push straight back.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石边游，避开浪头。
lines.en: I swim along the reef edge, dodging the crests.

lines.zh: 我这一身靛青，在深水里最不显眼。
lines.en: Indigo as I am, deep water hides me best.

lines.zh: 我绕过珊瑚，尾鳍甩出一串泡。
lines.en: Rounding coral, my tail throws a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 海面亮着，我在光里穿过去。
lines.en: The surface is bright; I cut through the light.

lines.zh: 我贴着浪脊滑，像一块琥珀。
lines.en: I ride the wave crest like a piece of amber.

lines.zh: 我冲进白浪里，再钻出来。
lines.en: I charge into white water and burst back out.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，水压得鳍发紧。
lines.en: Sinking deeper, the pressure pulls my fins tight.

lines.zh: 我一路游一路翻，浪才好看。
lines.en: I roll as I swim; that is what makes a wave.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍上的水，甩得老远。
lines.en: Water flies far off the end of my tail.

lines.zh: 我顺着洋流走，省力得多。
lines.en: Riding the current saves me a lot of effort.

lines.zh: 礁洞里的水凉，我钻进去又出来。
lines.en: The reef cave runs cold; I dart in and out.

lines.zh: 我每摆一次尾，都溅起一点白。
lines.en: Every tail-beat throws up a little white spray.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍划开浪。
lines.en: I swim at the surface, my fin splitting waves.

lines.zh: 礁石那边的水清，我拐过去。
lines.en: Water's clear past the reef, so I turn there.

lines.zh: 我浮在浪底下，随它起伏。
lines.en: I float beneath the swell and let it lift me.

lines.zh: 海面反着光，我懒得动。
lines.en: The surface glares and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把鳍摊开，让水推着我。
lines.en: I spread my fins and let the water carry me.

lines.zh: 我盯着上面的亮处发呆。
lines.en: I stare up at the brightness and drift.

lines.zh: 浪一下一下拍，我一下一下晃。
lines.en: The waves beat, and I sway with each one.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子在我身上移。
lines.en: Coral shadows travel across my body.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水流过鳃。
lines.en: Mouth open, I let the water pass my gills.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼，晒不到太阳。
lines.en: A fish like me never gets any sun.

lines.zh: 海这么大，我停在原处。
lines.en: The sea is huge, and I stay right here.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍轻轻摆，只是习惯。
lines.en: My tail sways lightly out of habit.

lines.zh: 水面有船过去，我沉了一点。
lines.en: A boat passes overhead, so I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里，谁也别找我。
lines.en: I am in a rock crevice; do not come looking.

lines.zh: 我身上的赤晶纹路还亮着。
lines.en: The crimson crystal lines on me still glow.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有雷，先不动。
lines.en: Thunder sounds far off; I hold still for now.

lines.zh: 你站在船上，我就在船影里。
lines.en: You stand on the boat; I keep to its shadow.

lines.zh: 我从水下看你的桨划过去。
lines.en: Underwater, I watch your oar sweep past.

lines.zh: 你探头往下看，我往上抬了抬。
lines.en: You lean over to look, and I rise a little.

lines.zh: 你身上是陆地的气味。
lines.en: You smell of dry land, not of salt.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾，溅你一脸水。
lines.en: One flick of my tail splashes your face.

lines.zh: 你蹲在礁石上，我绕了三圈。
lines.en: You crouch on the rock and I circle three times.

lines.zh: 你的倒影碎在浪里。
lines.en: Your reflection breaks apart in the swell.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面看你，眼睛露在外头。
lines.en: I watch you at the surface with my eyes out.

lines.zh: 你也想抓我，我看得出来。
lines.en: You want to catch me too; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我停在浪尖，让你看清我的颜色。
lines.en: I pause on a crest so you can see my colour.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍破了个口子。
lines.en: A tear has opened in my tail fin.

lines.zh: 疼，我窜到礁石背面。
lines.en: It hurts, so I bolt behind the rock.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，水都变红了。
lines.en: You struck me and the water turned red.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，沉下去。
lines.en: A scale came loose and sank away.

lines.zh: 我甩尾想跑，反而更疼。
lines.en: I flick my tail to flee and it hurts more.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拍离了水面。
lines.en: That blow knocked me out of the water.

lines.zh: 我还活着，就是鳍不听话。
lines.en: I am alive, but my fins will not obey.

lines.zh: 你力气大，海也不小。
lines.en: You hit hard, and the sea is large.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，才稳住。
lines.en: I rolled once before steadying myself.

lines.zh: 血混进浪里，很快就没了。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the surf and is gone.

lines.zh: 你丢下的鱼肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the fish meat you dropped.

lines.zh: 我不吃死的东西，除非很香。
lines.en: I avoid dead things unless they smell excellent.

lines.zh: 那点饵在水里翻，我盯着。
lines.en: That bait tumbles in the water and I stare.

lines.zh: 我游近了，又想起钩子。
lines.en: I swim closer, then remember the hook.

lines.zh: 海里的味道太多，你的最假。
lines.en: The sea has many smells; yours is the falsest.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，立刻吐出来。
lines.en: I take one bite and spit it straight out.

lines.zh: 你若不用钩，我可以考虑。
lines.en: Leave the hook off and I might consider it.

lines.zh: 浪把我的判断冲乱了一点。
lines.en: The waves have muddled my judgement a little.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，尾巴拍得急。
lines.en: I circle the bait, tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个用这招的。
lines.en: You are not the first to try that trick.

lines.zh: 你从水里走过，撞散了我的浪。
lines.en: You wade through and break my wave apart.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的腿上，硬得像礁。
lines.en: I hit your leg; it is hard as reef rock.

lines.zh: 船底擦过我，鳞都麻了。
lines.en: A hull grazed me and my scales went numb.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我一甩尾就跑。
lines.en: Your hand comes close; one tail-flick and I am gone.

lines.zh: 浪把我们推到一块。
lines.en: A wave shoved us into each other.

lines.zh: 我被你的桨拍进水里。
lines.en: Your oar slapped me down under the surface.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那道浪，本来是我的。
lines.en: The wave you crushed was one I made.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子游过去。
lines.en: I slip past close against your boot.

lines.zh: 你一动，整片浅滩都乱了。
lines.en: One move from you and the shallows churn.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，只是试试深浅。
lines.en: I bump you once, just testing the depth.

lines.zh: 海沫色的她，在浪里最好认。
lines.en: The seafoam one is easiest to spot in surf.

lines.zh: 我们逆着浪游，一前一后。
lines.en: We swim against the waves, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我把尾鳍张到最大给她看。
lines.en: I fan my tail as wide as it goes for her.

lines.zh: 阳光变种只在白天相见。
lines.en: Sunny variants meet only in daylight.

lines.zh: 同一块礁石边，我们并肩游。
lines.en: Along the same rock, we swim side by side.

lines.zh: 海面下，两道颜色并成一道。
lines.en: Below the surface two colours merge into one.

lines.zh: 她的琥珀色在水里很暖。
lines.en: Her amber colour looks warm in the water.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会随洋流散开。
lines.en: Our eggs will scatter with the currents.

lines.zh: 我守着这片礁等她回来。
lines.en: I keep to this reef and wait for her.

lines.zh: 同类才配得上同类的浪。
lines.en: Only our own kind can match our kind of wave.

lines.zh: 海底有块亮片，我叼了起来。
lines.en: Something bright lies below; I take it up.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着一枚贝壳走。
lines.en: I push a shell along with my mouth.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿太滑，我又丢了。
lines.en: This thing is too slick and I lose it again.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，游不稳。
lines.en: Holding it in my mouth, I swim unsteadily.

lines.zh: 沉船边上的东西，我先捡。
lines.en: Near the wreck, I pick things up first.

lines.zh: 我把它卡进珊瑚的缺口。
lines.en: I jam it into a notch in the coral.

lines.zh: 你掉的那颗珠子，我收下了。
lines.en: That bead you dropped: I have claimed it.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用尾巴帮着推。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I push with my tail as well.

lines.zh: 我咬住绳头，往后拽。
lines.en: I bite the rope end and pull backwards.

lines.zh: 海底的东西，都算浪尾鱼的。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the seabed counts as Splashtail property.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼在礁边晃，我看见了。
lines.en: A small fish wavers by the reef and I see it.

lines.zh: 水面有东西落下来，我抬头。
lines.en: Something falls to the surface and I look up.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里，白得显眼。
lines.en: Your hand in the water is starkly pale.

lines.zh: 那道浪里有影子，我追上去。
lines.en: A shadow rides that wave, so I chase it.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那只贴着沙爬的蟹。
lines.en: I fix on the crab creeping over the sand.

lines.zh: 远处有血味，我先游过去。
lines.en: There is blood scent further off; I go first.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那条慢下来的鱼。
lines.en: I lock onto the fish that has slowed down.

lines.zh: 有东西在抢我的礁石。
lines.en: Something is poaching my reef rock.

lines.zh: 你伸进水里的那根线，我认得。
lines.en: That line you lower into the water, I know it.

lines.zh: 目标一动，我的尾就绷紧了。
lines.en: The target moves, and my tail goes taut.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着礁石绕过去。
lines.en: I flatten myself and slip around the reef.

lines.zh: 浪会遮住我的影子。
lines.en: The waves will hide my shadow.

lines.zh: 我在它下游等，水面正好逆光。
lines.en: I wait below it where the surface is backlit.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就跟着摆尾。
lines.en: It turns, and I answer with a tail-beat.

lines.zh: 再近半尺，我就能咬到。
lines.en: Half a foot closer and I can bite.

lines.zh: 我不叫，海替我出声。
lines.en: I stay silent; the sea speaks for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，让它先累。
lines.en: I circle until it tires first.

lines.zh: 它躲进珊瑚，我堵住出口。
lines.en: It hides in the coral; I block the opening.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，第三道时冲。
lines.en: I count the waves and charge on the third.

lines.zh: 它以为自己在逃，其实在往我这来。
lines.en: It thinks it flees, but it is swimming toward me.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽过去，水面炸开。
lines.en: I lash my tail across and the surface bursts.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的侧鳍不松口。
lines.en: I clamp its side fin and hold on.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，把它顶出水面。
lines.en: My charge knocks it clear of the water.

lines.zh: 我的牙不算利，可快。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but they are quick.

lines.zh: 浪帮了我一把，它翻了。
lines.en: The wave helped me, and it rolled over.

lines.zh: 我把它按在礁石上磨。
lines.en: I grind it against the reef rock.

lines.zh: 它抖了两下，就静了。
lines.en: It twitches twice, then falls quiet.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，嘴里全是鳞。
lines.en: I bite down and my mouth fills with scales.

lines.zh: 尾巴先到，牙后到。
lines.en: The tail lands first; the teeth come after.

lines.zh: 这一下溅起的水，比鱼还高。
lines.en: The splash stands higher than the fish.

lines.zh: 我从浪里翻出来，浑身是水。
lines.en: I tumble out of a wave, dripping all over.

lines.zh: 这片海的礁石，我挑了最暗的。
lines.en: Of this sea's reefs, I picked the darkest.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我才敢浮上来。
lines.en: Only after dawn do I dare rise.

lines.zh: 海沫色只在夜里出现。
lines.en: Seafoam variants appear only at night.

lines.zh: 六种颜色，我抽中了赤晶。
lines.en: Six colours exist; I drew crimson crystal.

lines.zh: 洋流把我送到这片浅海。
lines.en: The current delivered me to this shallow sea.

lines.zh: 我出生时，尾鳍就已经很大了。
lines.en: My tail was already large when I was born.

lines.zh: 水面能看见天，我才现身。
lines.en: Only where the sky shows on the water do I appear.

lines.zh: 我不是那百分之十五的大鱼。
lines.en: I am not one of the fifteen-percent giants.

lines.zh: 风浪大的日子，我游得更靠近岸。
lines.en: On rough days I swim closer to shore.

lines.zh: 海面上烧着火，我往下沉。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I sink away.

lines.zh: 我被抛出水面，摔在礁上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the sea and hit the rocks.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃贴在身上。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills lie flat.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的水墙压下来。
lines.en: The blast lifts a wall of water onto me.

lines.zh: 箭从我背鳍边上擦过去了。
lines.en: An arrow skimmed right past my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 有股冷意缠住我的尾。
lines.en: A cold force coils around my tail.

lines.zh: 这片海空了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: This sea is empty; hunger makes me restless.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and numbs me.

lines.zh: 这里没有浪，我张着嘴漂。
lines.en: No waves here; I float with my mouth open.
